name: history
description: Commands to interact with the history of AWS CLI commands ran over time.

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.description: Shows the various events related to running a specific CLI command.

options.name: --include
options.description: Specifies which events to **only** include when showing the CLI command. This argument is mutually exclusive with ``--exclude``

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Specifies which events to exclude when showing the CLI command. This argument is mutually exclusive with ``--include``

options.name: --format
options.description: Specifies which format to use in showing the events for the specified CLI command. The following formats are supported:

args.name: command_id
args.description: The ID of the CLI command to show. If this positional argument is omitted, it will show the last the CLI command ran

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: Shows a list of previously run commands and their command_ids.
